coverLetter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Backend Developer position for your fintech SaaS platform. With 7+ years of experience building scalable web applications and RESTful APIs, I have a proven track record of delivering robust backend solutions that drive business results.

In my recent role at BSE America, I architected and developed an end-to-end CRM system with Laravel, implementing RESTful APIs for WooCommerce integration and electronic billing compliance. I reduced deployment times by 80% through CI/CD pipeline implementation and enforced code quality standards using automated testing and PSR-12 compliance. My experience with PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and AWS aligns closely with your tech stack requirements.

Previously at GET, I led the development of a multi-tenant document management system with RBAC and Elasticsearch, achieving sub-second search performance. I have hands-on experience with PHPUnit for automated testing, Sentry for monitoring, and tools like PHPStan and PHP-CS-Fixer for maintaining code quality.

I am particularly drawn to this opportunity because of the impact your platform has in the financial/procurement sector. I am eager to contribute to API design, database optimization, and architectural decisions while collaborating with your frontend team.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how my backend expertise and passion for clean, tested code can contribute to your team's success.
